commands:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
cd "$ROOT"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 356289656d66963fb7451b70eac2e1bcff015819
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = "$(git rev-parse 30bff5c930e9cff13b52f9bff67dc3e21ea06798^{tree})"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "ROOT_CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
git push origin --delete feat/unified-map-ux-20261104
echo "REMOTE_UX_BRANCH_REMOVED"
for WT in "$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1" "$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-baseline-20261104"; do
  if git worktree list --porcelain | grep -Fqx "worktree $WT"; then
    test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
    test "$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)" = ""
    git worktree remove --force "$WT"
    echo "REMOVED_WORKTREE=$WT"
  fi
done
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_CLEANUP_PASS"
